stemMarkdown: If 20 men can build a wall in 20 days, how many days will 15 men take to build the same wall, working at the same rate? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The wall needs $20 \times 20 = 400$ man-days of effort regardless of who does it. With 15 men that is $\dfrac{400}{15} = 26.6667$ days.
